prompt: Traditional crafts such as weaving, pottery and woodcarving are dying out in many parts of the world. Why is this happening? Do you think it is important to keep these skills alive?
essay:
In the past, many people was making things by hand, like cloth, pots and wooden furniture, but today these traditional crafts are disappearing in many countries. In this essay I will explain the reasons of this and give my opinion if we should protect them.

There are two main reasons why this is happening. The first reason is that the factory products are very cheap. A machine can make hundreds of plates in one hour, but a potter can make only few plates in one day, so the handmade things are very expensive and most of the customers do not want to buy them. The second reason is that young generation is not interested in these jobs. They prefer to work in the offices or in the IT companies, because the salary is more and the work is more comfortable. Also, it takes many years to learn a craft properly.

In my opinion, it is very important to preserve these skills. Firstly, the traditional crafts are the part of our culture and history. They show how our ancestors were living and what was important for them. If we lose them, our next generations will not know about their roots. Secondly, these crafts can attract the tourists, who like to buy the handmade souvenirs, so it can give the income to the villages.

In conclusion, the traditional crafts are disappearing because of cheap factory products and because young people are not interested. I believe the government should protect them by giving money to the craftsmen and opening the training centres, so that this important part of our culture does not die.
title: Why traditional crafts are dying out
